description: Read-only Model Context Protocol MCP server enabling code-driven AI analysis of Kubernetes clusters.
name: io.github.mikhae1/kubeview

environmentVariables.description: Path to kubeconfig file; defaults to ~/.kube/config if unset.
environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode: 'stdio' (default) or 'http'. The published package metadata still targets stdio by default.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: Server mode: 'code' (default), compatibility alias 'all', or direct 'tools'.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_MODE

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated configurable denials inside run_code. Environment overrides JSON; an empty value enables all configurable capabilities.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_CODE_MODE_DISABLED_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Argo Workflows capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ARGO_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Argo CD capability override: auto, on, or off. Auto uses Kubernetes API discovery or explicit remote configuration.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Logging level: 'error', 'warn', 'info' (default), or 'debug'.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Kubernetes context name to use. If unset, uses the current context from kubeconfig.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_KUBE_CONTEXT

environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for Kubernetes API (use 'true' or '1'). Not recommended for production.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_K8S_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY

environmentVariables.description: Enable global sensitive data masking. Set to 'true' or '1' to mask sensitive values in responses.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HIDE_SENSITIVE

environmentVariables.description: Default timeout in milliseconds for operations. If unset, uses plugin-specific defaults.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TIMEOUT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP bind host when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 127.0.0.1.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: HTTP port when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to 3000.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP endpoint path when MCP_TRANSPORT=http. Defaults to /mcp.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Prefer JSON responses over SSE in HTTP mode. Set to 'true' or '1' to enable.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_JSON_RESPONSE

environmentVariables.description: Shared secret of at least 32 bytes for signing approval state. Required in HTTP mode and identical across replicas.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_APPROVAL_STATE_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Absolute directory on writable storage shared by every HTTP replica, used to atomically prevent approval replay.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_APPROVAL_REPLAY_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Host allowlist for HTTP mode. Required when binding to 0.0.0.0 or ::.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Origin allowlist for HTTP mode.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Force the standalone code-mode runtime to use node:vm instead of isolated-vm. Set to '1' to enable.
environmentVariables.name: KUBE_MCP_FORCE_VM_SANDBOX

environmentVariables.description: Disable Kubernetes plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLE_KUBERNETES_PLUGIN

environmentVariables.description: Disable Helm plugin. Set to 'true' or '1' to disable.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLE_HELM_PLUGIN

environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_ARGO_TOOLS=off.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGO_PLUGIN

environmentVariables.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_ARGOCD_TOOLS=off.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLE_ARGOCD_PLUGIN
